title: Google reportedly taps AMD to design next-generation TPU — hybrid AI ASIC could integrate on-package CPU cores for reinforcement learning
summary: Analysts at SemiAnalysis believe Google may be interested in AMD's CPU cores for CPU-heavy workloads. A hypothetical Google design could therefore combine Google-developed TPU compute chiplets with AMD CPU and HBM in a tightly integrated package built by AMD.
